title: Arkret Minimal-Metadata Identity Link
description: Encrypted application-message or MLS private-extension payload that binds a Realm-scoped pairwise actor did_core_id to the real principal did_core_id for ak.profile.mls.minimal_metadata_realm.v1. The binding is scoped to both realm_id and trust_domain so the same pairwise mapping cannot be replayed across deployments. This object is never written to public Realm history unless a separate disclosure policy explicitly permits it.

pairwise_actor_id.description: Realm-scoped pairwise actor did_core_id used byte-for-byte in Event.actor_id and the MLS BasicCredential identity. Its Event proof verificationMethod controller is a did:key did whose registered adapter projection MUST equal this value.

principal_id.description: Real principal DID that controls or has disclosed the pairwise DID.

trust_domain.description: Deployment-scope trust domain. Receiver MUST require this value to match the current Realm / service trust_domain before accepting a pairwise DID -> principal DID mapping.

strand_id.description: Optional application-message context marker for the Strand carrying the identity link. It does not create independent membership or key scope; key scope is determined by effective_scope.

track_name.description: Optional display-track context marker for application routing. Track names do not create independent membership, policy, or MLS key scope.

mls_group_id.description: Optional MLS group identifier (base64url RFC 9420 GroupID) for diagnostic / cross-implementation correlation. NOT used by the reducer for authorization — authoritative MLS group state lives in ak.mls.genesis / ak.mls.commit events. Provided here so audit projections can quickly correlate an identity-link with its MLS group without replaying the full epoch chain.

response_signing_verification_method.description: Pairwise DID URL used only for generic history response PayloadProof signatures. Its controller MUST project to pairwise_actor_id.

response_signing_public_key_b64u.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 response-signing public key encoded as unpadded base64url.

response_signing_public_key_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the decoded response_signing_public_key_b64u bytes.

verification_method.description: DID URL of a key controlled by principal_id or by a disclosure proof accepted by Realm policy. Fragment is REQUIRED (this is a DID URL, not a bare DID). DID method-name normalized to lowercase per W3C DID 1.0.

payload_digest.description: Hash of canonical input bytes: utf8('ak.identity-link-v1\n') || canonical_json(identity-link object with proof.payload_digest and proof.signature omitted). The signed object includes trust_domain and the independent history response-signing key binding.
